newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-AUXERRE'S DENIAUD TO MISS GRASSHOPPER MATCH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-AUXERRE'S DENIAUD TO MISS GRASSHOPPER MATCH.

text.p: Auxerre striker Thomas Deniaud said on Saturday he will miss next Wednesday's European Cup Champions' League match against Grasshopper Zurich in Switzerland because of an ankle injury.

Deniaud, who scored twice against Glasgow Rangers and once against Grasshopper in Auxerre's last two European ties, was hurt after scoring the opening goal in his side's 7-0 thrashing of Lyon on Friday.
Midfielder and Auxerre captain Sabri Lamouchi is also out of Wednesday's game after injuring his knee while playing for France against Turkey in a friendly earlier this month.
